spans.s: जटा f. (r. जट् s. आ) coma implicata, involuta (*).

.
(*) Wils.: The hair matted as worn by the god Siwa,
and by ascetics; the long hairs occasionally clotted together,
and brought over the head, so as to project like a
horn from the forehead, at other times allowed to fall
carelessly over the back and shoulders.

जटायु et जटायुस् m. (e जट accumulatus et आयु vel आयुस्
vita) n. pr. vulturis fabulosi, Aruni, solis aurigae,
filii, quem Râvanus occidit. R. Schl.
जटिल (a जटा s. इल) implicatam comam habens.

जटुल m. (r. जट् s. उल) macula, nota in corpore. AM.: =
पिप्लु.
